Q: How do I request a refund?
A: You can request a refund through your account portal under Order History. Simply select the item you wish to return and follow the on-screen steps.

Q: Can I change my shipping address after placing an order?
A: If your order has not shipped, please contact support immediately with your order ID and the new address so we can update it.

Q: Do you ship internationally?
A: Yes, we ship to over 50 countries worldwide. Shipping fees and estimated delivery times are calculated at checkout based on your location.

Q: How do I reset my password?
A: Click on the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page. Enter your registered email address, and we will send you a secure link to reset it.

Q: What payment methods do you accept?
A: We accept major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, Amex), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and bank transfers for business contracts.

Q: How do I track my delivery?
A: Once your order ships, we will email you a tracking link. You can also view real-time shipping status in your customer portal.

Q: Is my credit card data safe?
A: Yes, we do not store raw card numbers. All payments are processed through a PCI-DSS compliant payment gateway using end-to-end encryption.

Q: What should I do if my item arrives damaged?
A: Please take a photo of the damaged packaging and the item, then contact our support team within 48 hours to initiate a free replacement.
Refund Policy: Customers can request a full refund within 30 days of purchase. The product must be returned in its original packaging with all manuals and accessories.
Acceptable Use Policy: Employees must not use company-provided networks or devices for unauthorized file sharing, illegal activities, or hosting personal commercial services.
Information Security Policy: Access to customer databases is restricted to authorized engineers with active business justifications. All database queries are logged and audited.
Remote Work Policy: All remote team members must access company assets via the official corporate VPN and ensure that local devices run up-to-date antivirus software.
Data Privacy Policy: We collect only the data necessary to provide our services. We do not sell or lease user information to third-party advertisers or brokers.
Travel Expense Policy: Travel expenses for corporate trips must be submitted with valid receipts within 14 days. Meals are reimbursed up to a maximum of $75 per day.
Password Complexity Policy: All employee passwords must be at least 14 characters long and contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number, and one symbol.
Code of Conduct: We expect all employees to maintain a respectful work environment. Harassment, discrimination, or abusive behavior in communication channels is strictly prohibited.

Setting Up SSL Certificates: We recommend using Let's Encrypt for automatic certificate generation and renewal. Ensure your DNS records are fully propagated before verification.
